###### 3.2.6. Control-point attributes

Attributes that cannot be read, but can only be written, notified or indicated are called control-point attributes. These control-point attributes can be used by higher layers to enable device specific procedures, for example the writing of a command or the indication when a given procedure on a device has completed.

###### 3.2.7. Protocol methods

The Attribute Protocol uses methods defined in Section 3.4 to find, read, write, notify, and indicate attributes. A method is categorized as either a command, a request, a response, a notification, an indication, or a confirmation; see Section 3.3. Some Attribute Protocol PDUs can also include an Authentication Signature, to allow authentication of the originator of this PDU without requiring encryption. The method and signed bit are known as the opcode.

###### 3.2.8. Exchanging MTU size

ATT_MTU is defined as the maximum size of any packet sent between a client and a server. A higher layer specification defines the default ATT_MTU value.

When using an L2CAP channel with a fixed CID, the client and server may optionally exchange the maximum size of a packet that can be received using the ATT_EXCHANGE_MTU_REQ and ATT_EXCHANGE_MTU_RSP PDUs. Both devices then use the minimum of these exchanged values for all further communication (see Section 3.4.2). A device that is acting as a server and client at the same time shall use the same value for Client Rx MTU and Server Rx MTU.

When using an L2CAP channel with a dynamically allocated CID, the ATT_MTU shall be set to the L2CAP MTU size.

The ATT_MTU value is a per ATT bearer value. A device with multiple ATT bearers may have a different ATT_MTU value for each ATT bearer.

###### 3.2.9. Long attribute values

The longest attribute that can be sent in a single packet is (ATT_MTU-1) octets in size. At a minimum, the Attribute Opcode is included in an Attribute PDU.

An attribute value may be defined to be larger than (ATT_MTU-1) octets in size. These attributes are called long attributes.

To read the entire value of an attributes larger than (ATT_MTU-1) octets, the ATT_READ_BLOB_REQ PDU is used. It is possible to read the first (ATT_MTU-1) octets of a long attribute value using the ATT_READ_REQ PDU.

To write the entire value of an attribute larger than (ATT_MTU-3) octets, the ATT_PREPARE_WRITE_REQ and ATT_EXECUTE_WRITE_REQ PDUs are used. It is possible to write the first (ATT_MTU-3) octets of a long attribute value using the ATT_WRITE_CMD PDU.

It is not possible to determine if an attribute value is longer than (ATT_MTU-3) octets using this protocol. A higher layer specification will state that a given attribute can have a maximum length larger than (ATT_MTU-3) octets.

The maximum length of an attribute value shall be 512 octets.

### Note

Note: The protection of an attribute value changing when reading the value using multiple Attribute Protocol PDUs is the responsibility of the higher layer.

###### 3.2.10. Atomic operations

The server shall treat each request or command as an atomic operation that cannot be affected by another ATT bearer sending a request or command at the same time. If an ATT bearer is terminated for any reason (user action or loss of the radio link), the value of any modified attribute is the responsibility of the higher layer specification.
### Note

Note: Sending an ATT_ERROR_RSP PDU should not cause the ATT Server to disconnect from the client. The client may upgrade the security and retry the request, so the server should give the client sufficient time to perform such an upgrade.

##### 4.10. Characteristic Value Notification

This procedure is used to notify a client of the value of a Characteristic Value from a server without expecting any Attribute Protocol layer acknowledgment that the notification was successfully received. There are two sub-procedures that can be used to notify a value: Single Notification^{1} and Multiple Variable Length Notifications. Notifications can be configured using the Client Characteristic Configuration descriptor (See Section 3.3.3.3).

A profile defines when to use notifications.

###### 4.10.1. Single Notification

This sub-procedure is used when a server is configured to notify a Characteristic Value to a client.

The ATT_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF PDU is used to perform this sub-procedure. The Attribute Handle parameter shall be set to the Characteristic Value Handle being notified, and the Attribute Value parameter shall be set to the Characteristic Value.

### Summary

Currently there are 3 functions used for bt_gatt_write-functionality:

  1. gatt write with response functionality
    
    int bt_gatt_write(struct bt_conn *conn, struct bt_gatt_write_params *params)

  2. gatt write without response but with a callback that the write has completed
    
    int bt_gatt_write_without_response_cb(struct bt_conn *conn, uint16_t handle,
    				      const void *data, uint16_t length, bool sign,
    				      bt_gatt_complete_func_t func,
    				      void *user_data)

  3. gatt write without any information if hte write has completed
    
    static inline int bt_gatt_write_without_response(struct bt_conn *conn,
    						 uint16_t handle, const void *data,
    						 uint16_t length, bool sign)

As one can see the parameters are inconsistent. This might be due to the difference btween a bt_gatt_complemete_func_t and a bt_gatt_write_func_t

### Describe the solution you'd like

I propose an encapsulation of the write_without_reponse-functions to have the same parameter list as the write-with-reponse-function:
    
    int bt_gatt_write_without_reponse(struct bt_conn *conn, struct bt_gatt_write_params *params)

The user can then decide wether they want to include a callback by setting the "func"-attribute wich also includes the bt_gatt_complete_func_t. If the parameter is left empty no callback is given.

### Alternatives

One can also create a "copy" of the bt_gatt_write_params-struct to have a seperate struct for complete-callbacks instead of write-callbacks.
One could also encapsulate the bt_gatt_write_params to be available for both with and without resonses and set the callbacks either as a seperate parameter or be part of 2 structs - one with responses and the other without:
    
    bt_gatt_write_params {
            /** Attribute handle */
    	uint16_t handle;
    	/** Attribute data offset */
    	uint16_t offset;
    	/** Data to be written */
    	const void *data;
    	/** Length of the data */
    	uint16_t length;
    #if defined(CONFIG_BT_EATT) || defined(__DOXYGEN__)
    	/** Att channel options. */
    	enum bt_att_chan_opt chan_opt;
    #endif /* CONFIG_BT_EATT */
    
    bt_gatt_write_with_reponse_params {
            /** Response callback */
    	bt_gatt_write_func_t func;
            /** Write params */
            bt_gatt_write_params write_params;
    }
    
    bt_gatt_write_without_reponse_params {
            /** Response callback */
    	bt_gatt_complete_func_t func;
            /** Write params */
            bt_gatt_write_params write_params;
    }

# Generic Attribute Profile (GATT)

The GATT layer manages the service database providing APIs for service registration and attribute declaration.

The GATT Client initiates commands and requests towards the GATT Server, and can receive responses, indications and notifications sent by the server. It is enabled through the configuration option: `CONFIG_BT_GATT_CLIENT`

The GATT Server accepts incoming commands and requests from the GATT Client, and sends responses, indications and notifications to the client.

Services can be registered using the `bt_gatt_service_register()` API which takes the `bt_gatt_service` struct that provides the list of attributes the service contains. The helper macro `BT_GATT_SERVICE()` can be used to declare a service.

Attributes can be declared using the `bt_gatt_attr` struct or using one of the helper macros:

> `BT_GATT_PRIMARY_SERVICE`
>     
> 
> Declares a Primary Service.
> 
> `BT_GATT_SECONDARY_SERVICE`

Attribute value changes can be notified using `bt_gatt_notify()` API, alternatively there is `bt_gatt_notify_cb()` where it is possible to pass a callback to be called when it is necessary to know the exact instant when the data has been transmitted over the air. Indications are supported by `bt_gatt_indicate()` API.

Discover procedures can be initiated with the use of `bt_gatt_discover()` API which takes the `bt_gatt_discover_params` struct which describes the type of discovery. The parameters also serves as a filter when setting the `uuid` field only attributes which matches will be discovered, in contrast setting it to NULL allows all attributes to be discovered.

Note

Caching discovered attributes is not supported.

Read procedures are supported by `bt_gatt_read()` API which takes the `bt_gatt_read_params` struct as parameters. In the parameters one or more attributes can be set, though setting multiple handles requires the option: `CONFIG_BT_GATT_READ_MULTIPLE`

Write procedures are supported by `bt_gatt_write()` API and takes `bt_gatt_write_params` struct as parameters. In case the write operation don’t require a response `bt_gatt_write_without_response()` or `bt_gatt_write_without_response_cb()` APIs can be used, with the later working similarly to `bt_gatt_notify_cb()`.

Subscriptions to notification and indication can be initiated with use of `bt_gatt_subscribe()` API which takes `bt_gatt_subscribe_params` as parameters. Multiple subscriptions to the same attribute are supported so there could be multiple `notify` callback being triggered for the same attribute. Subscriptions can be removed with use of `bt_gatt_unsubscribe()` API.

Note

When subscriptions are removed `notify` callback is called with the data set to NULL.

`#include <zephyr/bluetooth/gatt.h>`

Send multiple notifications in a single PDU.

The GATT Server will send a single ATT_MULTIPLE_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF PDU containing all the notifications passed to this API.

All params must have the same func and user_data (due to implementation limitation). But func(user_data) will be invoked for each parameter.

As this API may block to wait for Bluetooth Host resources, it is not recommended to call it from a cooperative thread or a Bluetooth callback.

The peer's GATT Client must write to this device's Client Supported Features attribute and set the bit for Multiple Handle Value Notifications before this API can be used.

Only use this API to force the use of the ATT_MULTIPLE_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF PDU. For standard applications, bt_gatt_notify_cb is preferred, as it will use this PDU if supported and automatically fallback to ATT_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF when not supported by the peer.

This API has an additional limitation: it only accepts valid attribute references and not UUIDs like bt_gatt_notify and bt_gatt_notify_cb.

Parameters
    
conn  | Target client. Notifying all connected clients by passing NULL is not yet supported, please use bt_gatt_notify instead.
num_params  | Element count of params array. Has to be greater than 1.
params  | Array of notification parameters. It is okay to free this after calling this function.

Return values
    
0  | Success. The PDU is queued for sending.
-EINVAL  | 

  * One of the attribute handles is invalid.
  * Only one parameter was passed. This API expects 2 or more.
  * Not all func were equal or not all user_data were equal.
  * One of the characteristics is not notifiable.
  * An UUID was passed in one of the parameters.
-ERANGE  | 

  * The notifications cannot all fit in a single ATT_MULTIPLE_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF.
  * They exceed the MTU of all open ATT bearers.
-EPERM  | The connection has a lower security level than required by one of the attributes.
-EOPNOTSUPP  | The peer hasn't yet communicated that it supports this PDU type.

Attempting to send more data than the current MTU results in warnings/errors such as:

The MTU update process is as follows:

  2. The server responds with the minimum of the requested MTU and the servers maximum MTU (`CONFIG_BT_L2CAP_TX_MTU`/`CONFIG_BT_L2CAP_RX_MTU`)

+  -> 板端接收缓冲
+  -> AUDCODEC DAC DMA
+  -> PA42/功放/扬声器
+```

+最小可行版本建议：主机保存 API key，调用 OpenAI 兼容的 TTS HTTP API；要求返回原始 PCM，主机侧重采样到 16 kHz 单声道；板端一次缓存并播放最多约 2 秒语音。BLE 不传一个“长属性”，而是新建音频写入特征，按当前连接的 `ATT_MTU - 3` 动态分片，并用应用层序号、总长度和 CRC 做完整性校验。

+“AI 女朋友”的亲密、温柔语气主要由 TTS 的 voice/instructions 和上游对话提示词决定。它不能由当前板端的 `g_tone[]` 方波表产生。

+## 1. TTS API 与音频格式
+
+### 1.1 OpenAI 官方接口
+
+OpenAI 官方 Text to Speech 文档说明，Speech API 的核心输入是 model、input text 和 voice；示例 endpoint 是 `POST https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech`，使用 Bearer ***REDACTED*** key 和 JSON 请求。[OpenAI Text to Speech 官方文档](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech)；[Create speech API reference](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/audio/subresources/speech/methods/create)
+
+适合本项目的请求形态是：
+
+```json
+{
+  "model": "gpt-4o-mini-tts",
+  "voice": "marin",
+  "input": "该休息一下了，我陪你走动两分钟。",
+  "instructions": "用温柔、自然、简短的女性陪伴语气说话。",
+  "response_format": "pcm",
+  "speed": 1.0
+}
+```
+
+上面的 voice 和 instructions 是方案示例，不是对“女声”或中文效果的现场保证。官方列出了内置 voices，并推荐 `marin` 或 `cedar` 获得较好质量；官方同时说明这些 voice 当前主要针对英语优化。中文在支持语言列表中，但需要在板端/实际扬声器上确认自然度。[Voice 与语言说明](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech#voice-options)
+
+OpenAI 官方还要求向终端用户清晰披露听到的是 AI 生成的声音而非真人声音。产品界面或说明中应保留该披露。[官方 TTS 文档中的披露要求](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech#text-to-speech)
+
+### 1.2 为什么选 PCM
+
+官方文档给出的输出格式包括 MP3、Opus、AAC、FLAC、WAV 和 PCM。PCM 被定义为不带 WAV header 的原始样本，格式为 **24 kHz、16-bit signed、little-endian**；官方还建议低延迟场景使用 WAV 或 PCM，以避免解码开销。[OpenAI 输出格式说明](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech#supported-output-formats)
+
+因此，第一版不建议把 MP3/Opus 解码器放进 SF32LB52 固件。主机桥接器收到 PCM 后，在发送前重采样为板端确定支持的格式，例如 16 kHz、单声道、16-bit little-endian。这样板端只做协议校验、缓冲和 DMA 播放。
+
+官方 TTS API 支持 chunk transfer streaming，可以在完整文件生成前收到音频数据。[OpenAI streaming audio 说明](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech#streaming-realtime-audio)
+
+不过，本项目第一版不必立即做“边生成边播放”。先采用“生成一段短语、校验完整、再播放”的方式，协议和故障边界更简单；确认带宽和缓冲后再改为流水式播放。

+## 2. BLE GATT 长数据、MTU 与分片
+
+### 2.1 一次 GATT 包能传多少
+
+Bluetooth Core Specification 的 ATT 部分规定，ATT bearer 的 MTU 是双方协商结果，双方继续使用交换值中的较小者；LE 默认 ATT_MTU 是 23。ATT 规范还规定，单个 notification 的 Attribute Value 最多为 `ATT_MTU - 3` 字节，单个 write request 的有效数据也受同样的 ATT PDU 开销限制。[Bluetooth Core 6.1, Part F ATT](https://www.bluetooth.com/wp-content/uploads/Files/Specification/HTML/Core-61/out/en/host/attribute-protocol--att-.html#UUID-0a2b8fae-8aca-8f6c-50b2-2b8b7e09ce2b)
+
+当前 VM 构建配置中可以直接看到：
+
+`/home/cmj/桌面/1/contest2026_329_dela/openvela/cmake_out/lckfb_huangshan_pi/.config:2962,2976-2979,3067-3069`
+
+关键值是：
+
+```text
+CONFIG_BT_DATA_LEN_UPDATE=y
+CONFIG_BT_BUF_ACL_TX_SIZE=27
+CONFIG_BT_BUF_ACL_RX_SIZE=1025
+CONFIG_BT_L2CAP_TX_MTU=253
+CONFIG_BT_ATT_TX_COUNT=7
+```
+
+`CONFIG_BT_L2CAP_TX_MTU=253` 是当前构建支持的上限配置，不等于每次连接的运行时 ATT_MTU 已经是 253。实现时必须在连接上通过栈的 MTU 查询接口获得实际值，再按 `bt_gatt_get_mtu(conn) - 3` 计算单片上限。Zephyr 官方 GATT API 提供 `bt_gatt_get_mtu()`、`bt_gatt_notify()`、`bt_gatt_notify_cb()` 等接口；当前项目使用的头文件和 API 命名空间也是 `zephyr/bluetooth/gatt.h`。[Zephyr 官方 GATT Server API](https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/doxygen/html/group__bt__gatt__server.html)
+
+### 2.2 为什么不能把整段语音作为一个长属性
+
+Bluetooth ATT 规定 long attribute 的最大 Attribute Value 长度为 512 字节；超过单包长度的读写要用 Read Blob 或 Prepare Write/Execute Write 程序，并且不再是一个原子操作。[Bluetooth Core 6.1, ATT long attributes](https://www.bluetooth.com/wp-content/uploads/Files/Specification/HTML/Core-61/out/en/host/attribute-protocol--att-.html#UUID-6beed4e0-734e-2119-bc79-260e0a2da7fa)
+
+一段 1～2 秒 PCM 是数万字节，不适合使用 GATT long write 作为单次事务。应将“语音流”定义为多个独立的应用层 frame：每片携带 stream id、chunk sequence/offset、payload length，并在开始/结束帧中传输格式、总长度和校验信息。
+
+### 2.3 可靠性选择
+
+ATT 规范明确指出，notification 和 command 没有 ATT 层响应或流控；在未增强 ATT bearer 上，因接收缓冲溢出而无法处理的 notification 可能被丢弃，command 也应视为不可靠。[Bluetooth Core 6.1, ATT sequential protocol](https://www.bluetooth.com/wp-content/uploads/Files/Specification/HTML/Core-61/out/en/host/attribute-protocol--att-.html#UUID-6beed4e0-734e-2119-bc79-260e0a2da7fa)
+
+建议的最小协议如下：
+
+| 帧 | 方向 | 作用 |
+|---|---|---|
+| `AUDIO_START` | 主机写入 | stream id、总字节数、采样率、声道数、位深、CRC32 |
+| `AUDIO_DATA` | 主机写入 | stream id、序号/offset、音频 payload |
+| `AUDIO_END` | 主机写入 | 声明传输结束，板端比较实际长度和 CRC |
+| `AUDIO_ACK/ERROR` | 板端通知 | 接收窗口、下一个期望序号、错误码 |
+
+具体传输可使用“Write Without Response + 小窗口 + ACK notification”。如果首版优先保证可靠而不是吞吐，则每片使用 Write Request，收到响应后再发送下一片；这会更慢但更容易定位丢包。不要复用当前只承载短命令的 Agent command 或 LLM response 特征。
+
+Bluetooth Core GATT 规范定义了 Write Characteristic Value、Write Without Response、Write Long Characteristic Value 和 Notification 等不同子程序，并要求写长值时使用 Prepare/Execute 过程。[Bluetooth Core 6.1, Part G GATT write procedures](https://www.bluetooth.com/wp-content/uploads/Files/Specification/HTML/Core-61/out/en/host/generic-attribute-profile--gatt-.html#UUID-9a9aa8e6-0033-c2c7-c0a1-cf25a9e1f4c1)

+## 4. 带宽与内存估算
+
+以下是原始单声道 16-bit PCM 的理论数据量；不含 BLE/GATT/应用层头部，也不代表现场可保证的吞吐量。
+
+| 音频格式 | 数据率 | 1 秒 | 2 秒 | 在 240-byte 应用 payload 下的片数 |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| OpenAI 原始 PCM：24 kHz | 48,000 B/s | 48,000 B | 96,000 B | 200 / 400 |
+| 建议首版：16 kHz | 32,000 B/s | 32,000 B | 64,000 B | 134 / 267 |
+| 更省带宽：8 kHz | 16,000 B/s | 16,000 B | 32,000 B | 67 / 134 |
+
+计算依据：`采样率 × 2 bytes × 秒数`；片数为向上取整的 `ceil(字节数 / 240)`。240 字节是假设运行时 ATT_MTU 为 253 且预留约 10 字节应用层 header 的工程估算；实际实现应使用 `max(1, bt_gatt_get_mtu(conn) - 3 - header_size)`。
+
+按当前驱动“每个样本占一个 32-bit DMA word”的方式，16 kHz、16-bit 音频若直接放入现有 DAC buffer，1 秒约需 64 KB，2 秒约需 128 KB；8 kHz、2 秒约需 64 KB。这解释了为什么“2 秒、16 kHz、整段缓存后播放”是当前内存下较合适的第一版边界，但它会占用现有的大块音频 buffer，不能再无计划地叠加多个副本。
+
+实际吞吐还受连接间隔、控制器分片、主机栈、ATT_MTU 是否成功协商、ACK 窗口和重传影响。当前 `CONFIG_BT_BUF_ACL_TX_SIZE=27` 说明链路层 ACL buffer 仍可能把较大的 L2CAP/ATT 数据拆成多个链路包；不能仅凭 `CONFIG_BT_L2CAP_TX_MTU=253` 宣称 253-byte 单包空口发送。

+
+1. 在 `velawear_llm_bridge.py` 中保留现有 Chat Completions 请求，得到简短中文回复。

+4. 主机重采样到 16 kHz、单声道；限制单次语音长度为 2 秒或更小，并在超限时截断到完整 PCM sample 边界。
+5. API key 只在主机环境变量/服务端，错误时继续保留当前文字 LLM 和板端 local fallback。
+
+### 阶段 B：独立 BLE 音频传输
+
+1. 新增 Audio Data characteristic，属性至少包含主机写入；不要复用当前 LLM response characteristic。
+2. 连接建立后查询实际 MTU；每个 `AUDIO_DATA` payload 动态限制在 `ATT_MTU - 3 - header_size` 以内。
+3. 用 `START/DATA/END` 加 stream id、序号、总长度、CRC32；先做顺序发送，丢片立即返回错误。
+4. 首版推荐 Write Request 串行确认，完成稳定性测试后再换成 Write Without Response + 4～8 片窗口 + ACK。
+5. 板端只接受预设格式（建议 16 kHz/mono/16-bit）、最大 2 秒和合法 stream id；收到错误或断连时立即丢弃未完成缓冲。

+### 阶段 C：板端 DMA 播放
+
+1. 在现有音频资源互斥锁下，先停止连续 MEMS 采集，再接收/播放语音；播放结束后恢复采集，并增加“同一进程恢复”的运行日志。
+2. 复用 `HAL_AUDCODEC_Transmit_DMA`、DAC channel 0 和 `DMA_REQUEST_41`，但数据源改成 PCM buffer，而不是 `g_tone[]`。
+3. 保留 mute-before-clock-settle 的顺序；PA42 只在确认硬件安全电平后打开，不能因为日志显示 DMA 完成就默认打开。
+4. 播放完成后执行 DMA stop、DAC mute、模拟路径关闭、缓冲回收，并返回 ACK/ERROR。
